prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid layout companion selection redesign: Redesign pet selection into a clear grid layout with structured choice cards to prevent custom pet creation errors.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select from our optimized pet companions designed for smooth desktop interaction."}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop control walkthrough step: Add a post-setup screen demonstrating right-click controls to show users how to hide, move, and interact with their pet.
   config: {"new_pet_controls": {"headline": "Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls, change settings, or hide it temporarily.", "layout": "card"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_controls"]}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move account sign-in after pet customization: Move sign-in after pet picking and photo upload screens so users build attachment before being asked to sign in.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [home, new_flow] Setup status checklist during generation: Replace the static waiting screen with an active checklist flow showing desktop asset generation progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Preparing desktop animations and pet behaviors", "style": "plain"}]}}
4: [choose_path, hint] Path processing time hint: Add a clear hint comparing fast adoption vs custom creation build times on the choose path screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Preset pets ready instantly. Custom pets take about 2-3 minutes to render."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Estimated wait time display: Show estimated processing time and active tips while pet assets load on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
6: [sign_in, notification] Cloud account protection notice: Display an explicit cloud save notification on sign-in clarifying that logging in prevents pet data loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your pet to your cloud account so your progress is never lost.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Save Protected", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
7: [adoption, layout] Stage layout for adoption certificate: Change the adoption certificate screen to stage layout to emphasize pet completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate"}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop discovery guide copy: Update home_intro text with clear instructions on where on screen the pet appears upon finishing.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look near your taskbar to greet your new companion. Drag them anywhere you like."}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Carousel story onboarding layout: Switch story screen to carousel layout to introduce desktop pet capabilities dynamically.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Teammate"}}

Adds a post-setup controls walkthrough screen after home_intro within allowed bounds.
Reorders sign_in step after pet customization without removing any required onboarding steps.
Replaces static waiting screen with an active checklist showing asset generation progress.
Adds an informative processing time hint comparing path options on choose_path screen.
Displays real estimated wait time and progress on the waiting screen.
Adds an informative cloud save notification to the sign_in screen.
Updates adoption certificate layout to stage format while maintaining official certificate context.
Updates home_intro copy to instruct users on desktop pet controls and placement.
Changes story screen layout to carousel while continuing to introduce the pet.
